activateRoutine: Triggers a multi-action automation routine.; routine, not a scene
activateScene: Activates a pre-configured smart home scene.; scene, not a routine
calibrateCameras: Resets the calibration of Autopilot cameras.; smart_car cameras only
castContent: Casts media content from a URL to a target device.; from a url only
getBiometricData: Retrieves specific biometric data (e.g., Heart Rate, Blood Oxygen).; any type, hrv or stress
getHRV: Retrieves Heart Rate Variability (HRV) data for a specified period.; hrv period only
getLightState: Returns the current On/Off state and brightness of a light.; returns only
playMedia: Plays specified media content on a target device.; by query, not a url
rebootDevice: Performs a soft reboot of a device.; reboot only, not firmware
resetFilterStatus: Resets the filter life counter after a filter replacement.; filter, not a light
setAmbientLighting: Sets the color and brightness of the interior ambient lighting.; smart_car cabin only
setApplianceMode: Sets the operating mode and parameters for a smart appliance.; one appliance only
setBrightness: Sets the brightness level (0-100%) for a dimmable light.; level only
setColor: Sets the color of a light using HSB (Hue/Saturation/Brightness) values.; smart_home hsb only
setColorTemperature: Adjusts the white light temperature (Kelvin) from warm to cool.; kelvin only, no color
setGroupLightState: Controls the state of a group of lights simultaneously.; a group, not one light
setHapticStrength: Adjusts the intensity of haptic vibration feedback.; vibration, not biometric
setLighting: Controls the power, brightness, and color of a light in a single command.; one light, not a group
setRomanceMode: Displays a virtual fireplace on the screen with heater activation.; smart_car only
setSecurityMode: Sets the arming state of the security system.; arming state only
startCleaning: Starts a cleaning cycle on a robot vacuum/mop, optionally for specific zones.; cleaning only
streamCamera: Starts a live video stream from a security camera.; live stream only
updateFirmware: Initiates a firmware update for the specified device.; firmware only, not reboot
